caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular stone relief with a sculptural scene in the upper portion and an inscription in the lower portion. The relief is rendered in shades of grey and black, suggesting it is a graphite or charcoal drawing on a light, off-white background. In the upper section, there are two human figures: the figure on the left is robed and holds a staff or spear, while the figure on the right is dressed in a more decorated manner, possibly wearing armor or a tunic, and is reaching out to shake hands or grasp the hand of the left figure. Both figures stand beneath an arch formed by a set of columns on either side, with decorative arches and vegetation-like patterns above them. The bottom section displays a block of capitalized text carved into the stone, spanning four lines and centered within the rectangular border. The text reads: "DAVID UND JONATHAN / WARLICHO WAR. DER HER / LIEBT UND SO DIS STATT". The entire stone slab is set off from the background with some shading around its borders, suggesting it is depicted in slight relief from the page.
title: Pa. German Stove Plate
